snow.config.title: Snow
snow.config.option.description.accumulat: Snow piles up while it snows. How deep and how fast depends on the biome, and the snowiest biomes can reach 12 layers.
snow.config.option.description.generatio: Newly explored areas start with snow of different depths, depending on the biome.
snow.config.option.description.melting.g: Snow melts one layer at a time instead of all at once.
snow.config.option.description.melting.m: Snow melts in warm biomes where it would normally rain, even in the dark.
snow.config.option.description.harvestin: Right-click snow with a shovel to clear it instantly and collect snowballs. Only works when nothing is on top of the snow.
snow.config.option.description.startup.s: Lets snow settle in the same space as plants and other blocks. While this is on, players joining your server need Snow installed. Takes effect after restarting the game.
